Town Government

Town departments

The Town of Millbrook is organized into ten line departments and several appointed boards and commissions. Each department operates under the supervision of the Town Manager and serves residents Monday through Friday from Town Hall, the Public Library, or a department-specific location. Use this directory to find the right office for your question.

Town Hall: 1 Cobbett Square · Mon–Thu 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. · Tue until 7 p.m. · Fri 8:30–1:00
Main switchboard: (774) 555-0100
After-hours emergencies: 911

Can’t find what you need?

The main switchboard at Town Hall is staffed Monday through Friday during regular business hours and can connect you to any department or take a message. For after-hours emergencies dial 911. For non-urgent inquiries outside business hours, email info@millbrook-ma.gov and you will receive a response within one business day.
